renderer_issues.issue: The renderer reports name_collision for Item_80266FCC and Item_80267AA8, both proposed as Item_Init, and for Item_8026A294 proposed as Item_CollisionThink. It preserves canonical names for these bindings.
The renderer reports shadowed_binding for Item_8026862C proposed as Item_Create and preserves its canonical name.

Rendered external-callee names suggest additional gameplay meanings not verified by their bodies in this shard; those meanings were not adopted. All three assigned pages report zero parse errors and retain matching line positions.
Renderer reports name_collision for proposed Item_Init and preserves the canonical symbol.
Renderer reports shadowed_binding for proposed Item_Create and preserves the canonical symbol.
Renderer reports name_collision for proposed Item_CollisionThink at procedure registration; this shard does not establish the callback's behavior.
Rendered Item_SpawnGroundedTracked implies a meaning for x10=1 that this wrapper does not establish.

Item_AddAnimAllExceptDynamicBones is a useful shorthand but omits important conditions: exclusion requires non-null anim_joint; matching skeletons skip their subtrees, and sibling continuation in that branch requires anim_joint->next.
Renderer reports shadowed_binding for Item_Create and leaves the canonical symbol unchanged.

Renderer reports name_collision for the shared proposed name Item_CollisionThink and leaves both canonical names unchanged. This shard establishes the body of Item_80269978, not equivalence between the two functions.
The renderer reports name_collision for proposed Item_CollisionThink and correctly leaves the canonical symbol unchanged.

The proposed itShouldApplyShieldHitlag is potentially narrower than its visible usage: the predicate also gates xCA8 assignment for clank and dealt-damage callbacks. Its body was not reviewed, so the proposed meaning remains unverified.
Both propose Item_Drop; the renderer reports name_collision and preserves canonical names. Their signatures and setup calls differ, so the shared hypothesis loses useful distinctions.
Both propose Item_PlaySFX; the renderer reports name_collision and preserves canonical names. They update different slots and have materially different replacement and sentinel behavior.
Renderer reports shadowed_binding and leaves both canonical names unchanged despite proposed spawn names.
Renderer reports name_collision because both proposals are Item_Drop; both declarations retain canonical names.
Renderer reports name_collision because both proposals are Item_PlaySFX; both declarations retain canonical names.
